name: fintrack
description: Fintrack: reads bank statement PDFs on your phone and shows where your money goes. No AI, nothing uploaded.

scripts.build: npm test && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk: npm test && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../dist && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../dist/Fintrack.apk
